description.value: Firehouse Subs is a North American sandwich chain with a first-responder theme, serving hot toasted subs with a portion of proceeds supporting the Public Safety Foundation of Canada. The Mission location sits on the Lougheed Highway, a main arterial route through the Fraser Valley used by touring cyclists heading east or west. The chain offers online ordering, a rewards app, and catering, making it a convenient stop for a quick hot meal on a longer ride.
